honestNegatives: Task premise said 13 committed bundle clips; git only tracks 3 clip.mp4 files (afn-sasebo-rally1, wm-dink-01, wm-volley-02). The other 10 wavea-* / afn-* bundles are annotation-only (corpus media is gitignored/re-derivable per .gitignore). Measured envelope exists for 3 clips, not 13; missingClips are named in the measurements JSON.

camera_motion proxy (global frame diff) conflates subject motion with camera motion — all 3 static-mount clips land DEGRADED because players move. The proxy detects instability but its v0.1 band is clearly miscalibrated for static-camera-with-action footage; this is exactly the kind of constant that must be learned from evidence before promotion.

motion_blur Laplacian-variance values (≈1970-2306) sit far above the v0.1 supported floor (100); the floor is untested against genuinely blurred captures — no blurred negative example exists in the committed set.
player_pixel_height / player_visibility are contract-only here: pose extraction (Apple Vision) is macOS-only, so both are NOT_MEASURED on all clips and no pose numbers were fabricated.
No verdict here says anything about downstream analyzability — thresholds have never been validated against cascade outcomes; every verdict is stamped provisional.
blocked: Empirical threshold learning: needs a labeled corpus linking envelope measurements to downstream analyzability (usable-result outcomes); the 3 committed clips are too few and contain no UNSUPPORTED exemplars.
Pose-derived dimensions: blocked on macOS-only pose extraction (or on-device capture telemetry) to produce player pixel height / visibility measurements.
The 10 annotation-only bundles cannot be measured until their media is re-derived via lab:acquire/lab:factory (media not committed).
